metrics.scope: Heldout frequencies and fresh sample-domain noise. Output-only calibration leaves feedback and input identical. Double-null maps use sampled plant, causal digital compensators and unit applied input per frequency; they are not closed-loop scalar transfer functions.
metrics.digital_implementation: Bilinear rational ratios plus integer delay and first-order Thiran remainder; 400 microsecond common delay on each side. Digital oracle includes discretization/hold residual, not exact continuous cancellation.
